lhs: Reduce the row-major reshaped dense operand on the selected axes.
rhs: Reduce the original dense operand on all axes except the paired surviving axes.
conditions: The same surviving shape, including every extent. All surviving axes are paired singleton-to-singleton factors. Static ordered equal-volume common-factor groups, arbitrary rank including scalar and zero extents; source-to-descriptor normalization assumed.
types: Arbitrary scalar type, total pure binary reducer, arbitrary seed; fixed logical row-major left fold.
overlap: Two replacement programs: removing reshape preserves surviving shape; moving reshape preserves surviving volume. Shared projection proof and effort. Distinct from deleting unit reduction axes and reducing a transposed input.

lhs: Reduce the row-major reshaped dense operand on the selected axes.
rhs: Reduce the original operand on the paired reduced axes, then reshape its output to the original surviving shape.
conditions: Equal surviving volumes suffice for the final reshape. All reduced axes are paired singleton-to-singleton factors. Static ordered equal-volume common-factor groups, arbitrary rank including scalar and zero extents; source-to-descriptor normalization assumed.
types: Arbitrary scalar type, total pure binary reducer, arbitrary seed; fixed logical row-major left fold.
overlap: Two replacement programs: removing reshape preserves surviving shape; moving reshape preserves surviving volume. Shared projection proof and effort. Distinct from deleting unit reduction axes and reducing a transposed input.

lhs: Reduce a broadcast along a subset of its mapped target axes.
rhs: Reduce corresponding base axes, then broadcast the surviving base axes at each old target minus the number of preceding deleted target axes.
conditions: Strictly increasing equal-extent broadcast map, arbitrary finite static shapes including zeros and rank zero, single-output logical ordered fold, any subset of mapped axes selected.
types: Any element type, same on both sides, pure binary reducer, arbitrary initializer.
overlap: Different from reducing newly introduced axes or eliminating an empty reduction; equal-extent HLO broadcast, excluding client-level mapped singleton expansion.

excluded_diagnostic.reason: Client [1,2]→[3,2] mapped expansion violates ShapeVerifier::HandleBroadcast equal-extents guard; compute [12,-9] vs [4,-3] but no benchmark refutation.

lhs: Apply a pure elementwise user to an ordered sequence of array and scalar broadcasts.
rhs: Apply the same user on the smaller frame after rebroadcasting scalar operands, then broadcast its result.
conditions: Arbitrary finite ranks/arity, common ordered map for arrays, arbitrary result type; static HLO has equal mapped extents. Client singleton expansion selects coordinate zero.
types: Heterogeneous argument types, pure extensional values, dense static arrays.
overlap: Binary homogeneous add/multiply are historical specializations. Broad theorem and equal-extent theorem count once; the caller and helper denote the same transformation.

lhs: Sum negated rank-one values with a two-sided zero initializer.
rhs: Sum original values with the same initializer and negate the resulting scalar.
conditions: Closed binary32 zero-sign fragment, RNE, identity -0, at least two input elements. [+0,-0] yields +0 versus -0.
overlap: Exact additive-group result has a single zero; a distinct strict-bit observation with order-independent witness. Native permissions and reachability are open.

lhs: Reduce the mantissa precision of a binary32 tensor on the nearest-even grid with full exponent budget.
conditions: Eight exponent bits and m+1=24, every binary32 word, logical observation by all 32 bits at each coordinate.
types: Raw binary32, including signed zero, subnormals and NaN payloads in the declared encoding.
overlap: No earlier terminal for ReducePrecision. Earlier integer/binary32 conversion changes element type.

lhs: Scatter a nonempty batch of empty index vectors using scalar inserted windows and modular addition.
rhs: Map addition pointwise over the original array and same-shaped updates.
conditions: Operand/update/result all [n], indices [n,0], explicit vector axis 1, no start components, inserted operand axis 0. Duplicate indices allowed. At n=2 the outputs are [8,0] and [3,5].
types: Static dense 32-bit modular words; exact order-independent observation.
overlap: Earlier empty-index witness used different operand/update shapes and a first-update map. This witness meets equal-shape guard under stated dimension numbers. No native run.

lhs: Copy from original storage into a middle layout and then to a final layout.
rhs: Copy directly to final layout; forward the original memory when final layout equals original.
conditions: Each dense static layout bijects logical coordinates and all n storage slots. Includes zero extent and differing intermediate/final layouts.
types: Arbitrary element payload, equality at every final physical element address.
overlap: Single composition law and its identity-layout specialization counted together. Lifetime/placement and padded or tiled holes are outside the observation.
